name: DEGENERATE STAR
source:
You have been assigned to investigate the S.S Vandermeer - a small research vessel drifting out into space, no longer responding to hails. VLSA didn't give you a choice, and it seems like no one else on this mission got one either. Who you work with and what you discover will not only shape the fate of the Vandermeer's crew, but also your own.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4751190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你受命前往调查“范德米尔号”——一艘孤零零漂浮在宇宙深处、不再回应任何呼叫的小型科研考察船。VLSA没有给你留任何拒绝的余地，而参与此次任务的其他成员似乎也同样身不由己。你选择与谁合作、又将在船上发现什么秘密，不仅将决定“范德米尔号”全体船员的命运，也将决定你自己的生死结局。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4751190/]Steam[/url]]
